mapper.insert: INSERT INTO worldcup_wins (user_id, food_name, runner_up, round_size) VALUES (#{userId}, #{foodName}, #{runnerUp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{roundSize})
mapper.select: SELECT food_name, SUM(win) AS wins, COUNT(*) AS finals FROM ( SELECT food_name, 1 AS win FROM worldcup_wins UNION ALL SELECT runner_up, 0 AS win FROM worldcup_wins WHERE runner_up IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY food_name HAVING SUM(win) > 0 ORDER BY wins DESC, finals DESC, food_name FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
